rationale: The round 3 exchange has clarified the numbers and narrowed the credible options to hybrid versus closure-led restructuring, but the core conflict remains unresolved: employee-side actors still reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management and capital-side actors still require economically meaningful footprint reduction. Positions are firmer and more explicit, so further unstructured rounds are unlikely to shift the substantive gap without a mediator-driven quantification and trade-off exercise.
